declare @stt_rec varchar(max), @from smalldatetime, @to smalldatetime, @q nvarchar(4000) select @stt_rec = text from @k select data as stt_rec into #stt_rec from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@stt_rec, ',') select @from = min(ngay_ct), @to = max(ngay_ct) from c81$000000 a join #stt_rec b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec select a.* into #data from d81$000000 a
set @q = 'insert into #data select a.* from d81$%Partition a join #stt_rec b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, '', 'ngay_ct', @from, @to, 1, 1
select ma_vt, ma_kho, dvt, he_so, sum(so_luong) as so_luong, gia_nt2, sum(tien_nt2) as tien_nt2, max(tk_gv) as tk_gv, max(tk_dt) as tk_dt, max(tk_vt) as tk_vt, sum(ck_nt) as ck_nt, ma_thue, thue_suat, max(tk_thue) as tk_thue, sum(thue_nt) as thue_nt into #result from #data group by ma_vt, ma_kho, dvt, he_so, gia_nt2, ma_thue, thue_suat select '' as array$, a.*, case when @language = 'v' then b.ten_vt else b.ten_vt2 end as ten_vt from #result a left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt where a.so_luong <> 0
